issues.description: Several Level 3 and Level 4 rubric cells (D1.1 L3/L4, D1.2 L4, D1.3 L4, D1.5 L4) end with a trailing ellipsis indicating that the descriptor extends slightly beyond the visual cell. After round-2 trimming the cuts now occur on clean word boundaries rather than mid-word; the full text remains available on the printable rubric. Tight but readable, no blocking truncation.
issues.suggested_fix: Optional polish: shorten the affected L3/L4 descriptors by another 5-10 characters or widen the rubric table cells slightly so the trailing ellipses disappear. Not required for shipping.
